accessibility.contrast: Text must meet WCAG AA contrast over glass cards. Use text-[#2a1810] for readability.
accessibility.alt_text: QR code MUST have descriptive alt text 'Bengali Association Donation QR Code'.
accessibility.aria_labels: Add aria-label='Copy UPI ID' to the copy button.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-crimson) for interactive elements.

qr_code.description: The Bengali Association Donation QR Code

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a new page component `Donate.jsx` in `/app/frontend/src/pages/`.
Update `Navbar.jsx` (and any mobile nav) to include a prominent 'Donate' link that points to `/donate`. Use a distinct styling like `.bg-crimson` and `.text-white` rounded pill to make it prominent.
In `Donate.jsx`, implement a clean, centered layout using the existing `.glass` and `.paisley-bg` utilities.
Display the provided QR code (from media.image_urls) prominently in a well-spaced card.
Below the QR code, display the Payee Name: 'The Bengali Association', UPI ID: 'thebengali2002@kotak', and UPI Number: '9894280001'.
Implement a 'Copy' button next to the UPI ID. Use the `lucide-react` Copy icon (e.g., `<Copy size={18} />`).

When the user clicks the Copy button, copy 'thebengali2002@kotak' to clipboard (`navigator.clipboard.writeText`) and trigger a success toast using `sonner` (`toast.success('UPI ID copied to clipboard!')`).
Do NOT add any payment reference submission form or input fields. Keep the flow simple and direct.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="copy-upi-btn"`).
Ensure the page is responsive and fully contained within viewport on load without feeling cramped.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI outputs. Avoid uniform styling.
Create depth with layered design elements and z-index hierarchy.
Never apply universal transitions (`transition: all`). Target specific properties.
Do not center-align the main app container globally (`.App { text-align: center; }` is forbidden).
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp with interaction animations and correct brand colors).
Never use emoji characters for icons. Use `lucide-react`.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus states).
Use generous spacing (2-3x more than comfortable, e.g., p-8, p-12).
Always apply `data-testid` to interactive and key informational elements.
